thread:
Ana T: Customer request: fully airgapped private deploy, no mandatory outbound, but they need fast key revocation and forensic-grade audit logs. Thoughts?
Diego R: Lean design: local attestation blob (TPM-signed) -> local keystore-shim mints short decrypt tokens. Revocation via signed revocation-manifest (RM) that agents pull when online.
Ana T: How do we prevent token abuse while offline?
Wei L: Controls: per-cgroup token quota, kernel-enforced conntrack caps, and PoP tokens bound to ephemeral key from TPM. TTL = 30s.
Diego R: Offline-log integrity: append-only file + rolling HMAC chain; agent signs checkpoints with attestation key. On reconnect, upload chain for verification.
Ana T: Incident flow idea: local admin can request quarantine (signed) + ops signs RM; agent requires both to activate quarantine to avoid single-person mistakes.
Wei L: CVE note: our agent depends on netlinker v2.1.3; patch recommended. Short-term mitigations: run agent unprivileged, move conntrack ops to tiny suid helper with limited syscalls.
ops-bot: deploy: keystore-agent v1.9.1-rc -> canary start 6180001122; logs -> /var/log/redwood/keystore-agent-canary.log
Ana T: Action items: Diego -> RM format RFC; Wei -> PoP + quota spec; me -> update customer SLA language for offline audit retention.
Ana T: Thanks all. We'll review RFCs in Thursday sync. :thumbsup:
